names.note: Name page 9884 of days.pravoslavie.ru is «Анастасия (Камаева), инокиня, прмц.»; the grade and the rank are stripped and the surname kept, the day line itself giving only «Анастасии». `fk.mjs` on the stored string returns NONE and a Cyrillic grep for «Камаева» over every `saint.json` returns nothing.

death.note: The day line closes «(1937)», one year for the whole company of eight; no year of birth anywhere.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 28 июля ст. ст. — «Прмч. Василия , прмцц. Анастасии и Елены , мчч. Арефы , Иоанна , Иоанна , Иоанна и мц. Мавры (1937).»

attestations.note: The first of the two women the day's eleventh entry heads «прмцц.», venerable-martyrs, in an ENUMERATED COMPANY OF EIGHT which BRIEF.md §4 makes eight folders. The line and name page 9884 agree: «прмц.» and «инокиня», a nun, so `venerable-martyr` and `monastic` are both the source's own words; `monastic` is written where the page says «инокиня» because that is the word this corpus's `types` vocabulary carries. NO `office` IS WRITTEN. THE LINE AND THE NAME PAGE ARE ALL THERE IS: no life page stands behind the entry, and THE 26 ЯНВАРЯ SYNAXIS PAGE WAS NOT OPENED. The day page prints no hymn under any of the eight names.
